parsed.title: Discussion on tax filing, domain purchase, app feasibility and security concerns

claims.text: The user paid about 1000 UAH after re-filing with the help of aunt Sveta to avoid larger fines.
The tax calculator works only with a Ukrainian‑currency FOP and requires conversion based on the daily exchange rate.
The filing process takes about an hour with Excel, or roughly one day per month.
Quarterly reports must be submitted correctly to avoid penalties.
No domain has been purchased yet.
Someone suggests buying a calculator first to have money for a domain.
Web is the easiest platform but less profitable than Android/iOS.
Fast delivery (under a week) and a cross‑platform stack (Flutter) are considered essential for success.
The envisioned app would be a local‑first bundle with USD/UAH rates refreshed every 5 minutes and calculations performed in the browser.
There is skepticism about finding at least ten users willing to pay 299 UAH.
The app’s password is stored in local storage as a 100 % discount promo code.
Participants suspect the app is a scam and the bundle may contain pirated content.

decisions.text: Decision not to purchase a domain at this stage.

openQuestions.text: Is it possible to locate the source code or password by searching the bundle?
